title: Box Breathing Reset
note: Breathe in for four hold for four breathe out for four and repeat for one minute

title: 5 Senses Reset
note: Notice five things you can see four you can feel and three you can hear while your breathing slows

title: Tension Release Stretch
note: Roll your shoulders stretch your neck gently and unclench your jaw for a minute

title: Daylight Reset
note: Step outside or stand by daylight and stay there long enough to feel your body wake up

title: Hydration Reset
note: Pour a glass of water and drink it slowly before you do anything else

title: Focus Space Reset
note: Clear one small part of your desk and keep only what you need for the next task

title: Next Step Reset
note: Write down the very next action you can do in under five minutes and start with that

title: Campus Walk Reset
note: Take one short walk around campus or outside your building at an easy pace

title: Kind Message Check-In
note: Send one short message asking how someone is doing or letting them know you are thinking of them

title: Tea Reset Break
note: Make a warm drink sit down for a moment and let that break be your reset

title: Energy Boost Reset
note: Do a quick set of easy movements like marching squats or wall pushups

title: Calm Track Pause
note: Play one calming track and do nothing else until it finishes

title: Fresh Air Pause
note: Open a window or stand near fresh air and take a few slower breaths

title: Top 3 Focus Plan
note: Write down your top three priorities and circle the one you will start first

title: One-Song Reset
note: Put on one song and tidy or reset your space until it ends

title: 3 Good Things
note: Write three small things that went well today and why they mattered

title: Mindful Walk Break
note: Walk slowly and pay attention to your steps your breathing and what is around you

title: Easier Task Restart
note: Switch to the easiest useful task on your list and do only that for five minutes

title: Wrist Relief Stretch
note: Stretch your fingers wrists and forearms gently then shake out your hands

title: Mood Lift Track
note: Play one song that reliably lifts your mood and let yourself listen properly

title: Posture & Breath Reset
note: Sit tall drop your shoulders place both feet on the floor and take five slow breaths

title: Nourishing Snack Break
note: Make a simple snack that feels steadying and eat it without rushing

title: One-Page Restart
note: Read one page of notes and underline one point that matters most

title: Light Boost Pause
note: Step into natural light for two minutes and look up from your screen

title: Social Walk Plan
note: Message someone with a simple plan to walk or catch up later

title: Set Up Tomorrow
note: Leave out tomorrow's notes clothes or bag so the morning feels easier

title: Guided Calm Reset
note: Play a short guided calm or breathing video and follow it all the way through

title: Stair Boost Break
note: Walk up and down a staircase or do a quick movement burst to wake up your focus

title: Mind Clear Dump
note: Write down everything on your mind without editing until the page feels lighter

title: Sensory Reset
note: Pause and name what you can see hear feel smell or taste right now

title: Phone-Free Focus
note: Put your phone out of reach turn it face down and begin the task in front of you

title: Tea Chat Break
note: Invite someone for a short tea or coffee break and keep it light

title: Evening Wind-Down Stretch
note: Do a few slow stretches with low light and a quieter pace

title: Sleep Breathing Pause
note: Lie or sit comfortably and take five slow breaths before trying to sleep

title: Walk & Call Reset
note: Call someone while you walk outside at an easy pace

title: 10-Min Focus Sprint
note: Set a ten minute timer pick one task and stay with it until the timer ends
